newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude creeps up in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude creeps up in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: Benchmark Brent crude creeped up in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, with a major Wall Street broker attributed with most of the selling, traders said.
June Brent partial cargoes changed hands six times between $18.05 and $18.10 a barrel.
June Brent settled at $18.06 on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
May/June Brent moved three times at minus 22, 23 and 25 cents a barrel, down from minus 18 cents earlier in the day.
